newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up on LME rise, seen hitting 14 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up on LME rise, seen hitting 14 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended six cents higher at 13.83 ringgit ($5.50) a kg on Friday after tracking an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good demand after the LME went up last night," said a trader in Kuala Lumpur. "I think the market will hit 14 ringgit level by next week."
"Yes, it looks the 14 ringgit is achievable soon," said another trader. "The demand is good now and the LME is strong."
Bids outnumbered offers by 148 tonnes to 84. Final turnover was 118 tonnes, against 84 on Thursday. The local premium against the LME narrowed to $45 a tonne from $55 previously.
